title: Detect deterioration from store data first
trigger: when checking whether the memory store is deteriorating
behavior_delta: Run supermem_health or node src/cli.js health before asking a model to prune. Do not judge truth with an LLM first.
what: Deterioration is live-set failure: bloat, prefix crowding, trigger Jaccard, dead inferred, contest, churn, cap saturation.
why: Detection must work on a cold store. The model prunes from the report.

retrieval_forms.micro: Health is counts, not an LLM.
retrieval_forms.short: Use supermem_health. Detect with SQLite metrics, then optionally ask the model to prune.
